subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Colloquial
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 2' **i.e. **'Conversational'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **'Colloquial'** refers to language used in ordinary or familiar conversation; it's not formal or literary.(बोलचाल संबंधी) 
 
• The synonym **'Conversational'** also denotes language that is used in informal conversation.(वार्तालापिक)

Therefore, the** correct answer** is:** 'Conversational'. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Now, let's go through the **other options**:

 
 
• **'Lexical'** refers to the vocabulary of a language.(शब्दसंबंधी) 
 
• **'Prosodic'** relates to prosody, which is the study of rhythm, intonation, stress, and related attributes in speech.(स्वर संबंधी)
 
• **'Linguistic'** refers to anything related to language or linguistics.(भाषा संबंधी) 
 
 

3d:Tb6b,

The correct answer is** 'Option 1'.**</p&g
